subject: Temporary quota increase (flex headroom) & rate harmonization for ClearBay launch
messages:
From: Maya Patel <maya@clearbay.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-25T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Launch week - temporary headroom & overrun rate request

Hi Mateo,

We’ve got an initial launch window for ClearBay’s new recommendation engine: traffic is expected to spike starting Oct 3 for ~10 days. At current committed capacity we’ll hit hard caps by day 2. Can Redwood provision a temporary quota increase (ephemeral headroom) for the launch and give us a more favorable overrun rate for the uplift period?

High-level asks:
- +3x burst headroom for 10 days (estimate attached forecast)
- capped invoice exposure (a hard ceiling we can agree in advance)
- blended overrun rate that’s lower than standard paygo while this is a short-term ramp

We’re open to a short addendum and can sign quickly. Also: budget team would like a one-time launch credit if actual usage falls below the forecasted uplift.

Attaching our forecast and a quick usage snapshot.

Thanks,
Maya Patel
Head of Launch Engineering
ClearBay

Attachments: clearbay_launch_forecast_20260924.xlsx (XLSX), usage_snapshot_20260924.csv (CSV)
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Patel <maya@clearbay.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-25T10:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Launch week - temporary headroom & overrun rate request

Hi Maya — thanks for the details and attachments. Congrats on the launch! We can absolutely support a short-term uplift and work with you on a capped exposure.

What I can propose immediately (subject to final approvals):
- Provision ephemeral headroom equal to 3x your committed QPS for a 10-day window starting Oct 3.
- Offer a blended overrun rate for that window: $0.0009/token (vs standard paygo $0.0016/token) for uplift traffic only.
- One-time launch credit: contingent on forecast accuracy, we can offer a partial credit for unused uplift (mechanics below).

We typically require a quick addendum to the Master Services Schedule (SLA Addendum) to lock dates and the invoice ceiling. I’ve attached a draft SLA_Addendum_v2.pdf for review.

Two quick clarifications so I get approvals faster:
1) What timezone your launch is measured in and exact start/end times (UTC preferred).
2) Confirm whether the budget cap is a hard dollar ceiling or a token cap.

If you’re available I can put together a short call with our finance/ops folks tomorrow to finalize.

— Mateo
Acct Exec, Redwood Inference
Attachments: SLA_Addendum_v2.pdf (PDF)
From: Maya Patel <maya@clearbay.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-25T12:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Launch week - temporary headroom & overrun rate request

Thanks Mateo — that sounds promising.

Answers:
- Launch window: Oct 3 04:00 UTC -> Oct 13 04:00 UTC (10x 24h blocks)
- Budget cap: hard dollar ceiling (finance needs predictability)

We’d like the blended overrun rate to apply to all uplift traffic above committed baseline, and we’d prefer the ceiling to be set one increment above your blended estimate to avoid surprise throttles. For the credit: if we use <75% of uplift forecast, we’d like 50% of the difference back as a credit against next month’s invoice.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept those mechanics? If so, we’ll sign the addendum and wire any initial administrative deposit you need.

Best,
Maya
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-09-25T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: FW: ClearBay launch - quick approval request (discount + credit)

Karthik / Ben — tagging you both for rapid approval and pricing sign-off. ClearBay (CLB-0231) requests:
- +3x ephemeral headroom Oct 3–13
- blended overrun rate for uplift traffic: propose $0.0009/token
- hard dollar ceiling (ClearBay will accept one increment above blended estimate)
- credit clause: if actual uplift <75% forecast, they request 50% of the unused uplift spend returned as credit against next month

Proposal for approvals:
- Approve temporary uplift and blended rate as stated for a 10-day window
- Offer a launch credit of $5,000 or 50% of unused uplift spend, whichever is smaller (to balance risk)
- Require legal to sign SLA_Addendum_v2 and finance to confirm invoice/cap wording

Attached: SLA_Addendum_v2.pdf and their forecast. Need a quick sign-off so I can respond before EOD.

— Mateo
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-26T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ClearBay launch - quick approval request (discount + credit)

Thanks for the summary. I’m okay to approve with the following adjustments:
1) Approve blended overrun rate at $0.00095/token (midpoint) for the uplift window.
2) Approve a one-time launch credit capped at $5,000; if their calculation of "50% of unused uplift spend" exceeds $5k we cap it.
3) We require the hard dollar ceiling to be expressed as a firm invoice cap (dollar amount) in the addendum; finance will hold any disputed overages in escrow and reconcile after the window.
4) Legal to sign SLA_Addendum_v2 (please loop legal and send final doc).

Ben — please confirm billing flow / escrow mechanics. Mateo — send revised addendum with the $0.00095/token rate and the $5k capped credit; once legal signs we can execute and provision headroom.

— Karthik
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
